senses.gloss:
a. (compar. भ्रशीयस्, superl. भ्रशिष्ठ) 
__1 Strong, powerful, mighty, intense, excessive, very much. 
__2 Frequent. 
-शम् ind. 
__1 Much, very much, exceedingly, intensely, violently, excessively, in a high degree, greatly; तमबेक्ष्य रुरोद सा भृशम् [[Ku. 4. 26]]; रघुर्भृशं वक्षसि तेन ताडितः [[R. 3. 61]]; चुकोप तस्मै स भृशम् 3. 56; [[Ms. 7. 170]]; [[Ṛs. 1. 11.]] 
__2 Often, repeatedly. 
__3 In a better or superior manner. 
-Comp. 
-कोपन a. highly choleric or irascible. 
-दण्ड a. inflicting severe punishment; स्वराष्ट्रे न्यायवृत्तः स्याद्भृशदण्डश्च शत्रुषु [[Ms. 7. 32.]] 
-दुःखित, पीडित a. exceedingly afflicted. 
-संहृष्ट a. very much delighted.
Den. Ā. To become powerful or strong.

p. p. [भ्रस्ज्-क्त] Fried, roasted, parched. 
-Comp. 
-अन्नम् rice boiled and fried. 
-तण्डुलः parched rice; सुगन्धिः कफहा रूक्षः पित्तलो भृष्टतण्डुलः [[Rājanighaṇṭu.]] 
-यवाः (pl.) parched rice.

f. 
__1 Frying, parching, roasting. 
__2 A deserted garden or orchard. 
__3 A spike, point; शरभृष्टीः [[Bṛ. Up. 6. 4. 12.]]
